steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual. Replace all parts before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Load type and size
steps.body: Check laundry mix — single heavy item, tangled sheets, or small load can cause UV/UB.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check laundry mix — single heavy item, tangled sheets, or small load can cause UV/UB.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Pause, redistribute or remove items, press Start to continue.

steps.title: Hall sensor after rebalance
steps.body: If UV repeats on balanced load, suspect hall sensor or motor — run motor circuit procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: If UV repeats on balanced load, suspect hall sensor or motor — run motor circuit procedure.

steps.title: Rebalance load
steps.oemOutcome: Educate consumer on load size; redistribute and continue cycle.

steps.title: Motor/hall diagnosis
steps.oemOutcome: Run samsungwf6000r-motor-circuit when UV persists on balanced loads.

steps.title: Unbalance resolved
steps.oemOutcome: Load rebalance cleared UV — no part replacement.
